summary: Log Round refactor + hole-count-aware achievements fully verified. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass — new /api/users/{id}/achievements returns sub_50_9/sub_45_9/sub_40_9/sub_par_9/hot_streak_9 alongside existing 18-hole badges; sub_100 desc mentions '18-hole round'; a 9-hole-only user gets sub_50_9=true & sub_100=false; an 18-hole-only user with 85 gets sub_100=true & sub_50_9/sub_45_9/sub_40_9/sub_par_9=false. Frontend: Log screen field order is Holes → Par → Score; testIDs log-holes-9 / log-holes-18 / log-par / log-score present, deprecated log-toggle-holes / log-hole-grid / log-holes are gone. Default is 18 with par=72; tapping 9 flips par to 36; tapping 18 flips par back to 72; a hand-typed custom par (70) is preserved when switching pills. Notes uses MentionInput: typing '@sa' surfaces the mention-suggestions box with 'Sam Rivera'; tapping the row inserts '@Sam_Rivera ' (with trailing space). Full E2E: search 'Pebble' → select Pebble Beach Golf Links → tap 9 (par auto-36) → score 41 → notes '@Sam nice round' → Save; POST /api/rounds body was {course_name:'Pebble Beach Golf Links', total_score:41, par:36, holes_played:9, notes:'@Sam_Rivera nice round'}, response 200, feed updated. Regression: default 18/72 submit also works (POST 200). Comment mention side-check on Post detail (post-comment-input) also triggers suggestions with 'Sam Rivera'.

react_native_issues.issue: Unused legacy styles remain in StyleSheet after removing hole-by-hole toggle: holesHeader, holesSub, togglePill, togglePillText. Non-blocking dead code; can be cleaned up. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/log.tsx:463-478

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove unused styles (holesHeader, holesSub, togglePill, togglePillText) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/log.tsx now that the hole-by-hole toggle is gone.

Nit: the spec mentioned inserting '@Sam Rivera ' with a space, but implementation inserts '@Sam_Rivera ' (spaces in display_name replaced with underscore). This matches MentionInput.tsx behavior (line 75) and is consistent with Discover/comments — flagging it purely for spec alignment; no change needed unless you want the raw space.
critical_code_review_comments: log.tsx par auto-flip logic only overwrites par when it is empty, '72', or '36' — this correctly preserves user-typed custom pars (validated with 70).
achievements endpoint correctly treats missing holes_played as 18 (int(r.get('holes_played') or 18) >= 18), which is defensive for legacy rounds.
sub_par_9 uses per-round par (int(r.get('par') or 36)), which is correct: a 9-hole round posted with par=34 and score 33 would still count.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_ rounds under jordan@teebox.demo and sam@teebox.demo, plus two throwaway registered users (test9only_*/test18only_*) each with a single round. Round names are prefixed 'TEST' — safe to leave or bulk-delete by course_name regex.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in /app/frontend/.env. Auth token key in login response is 'access_token' (not 'token'). Discover users endpoint is /api/discover/users?q=... (not /api/users/discover). log-score and log-par testIDs are placed directly on the <input> element (TBInput passes testID through), so use [data-testid="log-par"] directly rather than [data-testid="log-par"] input.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug reproduction requested; all spec items behaved as designed.
